title: payment.screening.completed v1
description: Published by the screening service on topic payment.screening.completed with its verdict for one payment.screening.requested event. Message key: paymentId. An event that does not validate against this schema is sent to payment.screening.completed.DLT and never applied.

schemaVersion.description: Contract version. Always 1 for this schema.

eventId.description: Unique id of this verdict event (UUID). Redelivering it is harmless: (paymentId, eventId) is applied at most once.

verdict.description: CLEAR releases the payment for processing; REJECT rejects it; FLAG (needs an officer) and ERROR (screening could not decide) leave it HELD.

reasons.description: Human-readable reasons for the verdict. May be empty.

riskScore.description: Optional score from the screening model. Recorded, never used to decide anything here.

decidedAt.description: When the screening service decided (RFC 3339, UTC).

screeningRunId.description: Identifier of the screening run that produced the verdict, for tracing on the screening side.
